name: Ultralight White Oak Slats, Beige Felt
summary: White oak real wood veneer laminated onto 9 mm recycled acoustic felt, with a beige felt backing and no rigid core.

texture.note: Manufacturer spec overrides photo estimates: seven 1.20 in white-oak faces on 1.69 in pitches with 0.49 in, 90-degree V-grooves cut 6.2 mm into 9 mm felt (2.8 mm backbone, no rigid core); seven pitches total 11.83 in versus the listed 11.80 in panel width. The tile is seven pitches wide and 23.66 in tall, with muted pale oak and oatmeal-beige felt colors sampled from main.jpg; grain is synthesized and periodic with no baked lighting.
